transparent_logo.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit target: supplied transparent Lemniscate brand mark. Website asset. Preserve the exact double-line gold infinity ribbon, its cream center band, right cream four-point star, proportions and orientation. Make the existing star more legible on an off-white webpage by adding a crisp fine warm gold outline around the star, about the same weight as one sixth of the gold ribbon stroke. Keep the star cream-white, with its existing silhouette and place. Remove tiny speckle artifacts around the mark and internal negative spaces. Tight landscape crop around the complete infinity and star with a small 3% transparent margin. All background and negative spaces genuinely transparent. Clean precision edges. No new symbols, text, glow, shadows or background. This is the same logo with improved star contrast, not a redesign.
